blocks.html: Robinsons Land (RLC) has launched work.able Iloilo, its first and biggest flexible workspace center in Western Visayas to date, with more than 420 seats.

Located on the 10th floor of Cybergate Iloilo Tower 3, work.able Iloilo expands RLC’s flexible workspace portfolio beyond Metro Manila, introducing plug-and-play office environments within a fast-growing regional business hub.

The new flex center gives companies a fully serviced workplace where teams can set up quickly, add seats as needed, and stay connected to customers, talent, and regional markets without building a permanent office from the ground up.

“Iloilo presents a compelling opportunity for companies that want to grow beyond Metro Manila while staying close to talent, infrastructure, and regional markets,” said Jericho P. Go, Senior Vice President and Business Unit General Manager of Robinsons Offices, which serves as the landlord of work.able Iloilo. “With work.able now in Cybergate Iloilo 3, there is a ready platform for organizations to establish a flexible presence in Western Visayas and scale with greater confidence.”

Iloilo continues to emerge as a competitive regional business hub, driven by strong economic performance and increasing office demand. According to CBRE’s Q1 2026 market report, Iloilo is recognized as a top-performing provincial sub-district, positioning it as a viable alternative to traditional office locations such as Metro Manila and Cebu.

Companies expanding in the Visayas can benefit from Iloilo’s operational efficiency, skilled talent pool, and cost-competitive environment. work.able Iloilo supports regional operations, satellite teams, project offices, and interim workspaces for businesses preparing to transition to permanent sites.

The center is located beside Robinsons Pavia along Senator Benigno S. Aquino Jr. Avenue, also known as Diversion Road. Cybergate Iloilo Tower 3 is the closest premium Grade A office building to Iloilo International Airport, accessible through a 15-minute drive. The property is adjacent to a transport terminal with bus and jeepney routes, and tenants benefit from immediate access to retail, dining, and essential services within a well-integrated commercial environment.

work.able Iloilo features over 420 workstations across 25 private offices, boardrooms, meeting rooms, focus pods, and hot desk options. Private offices support longer-term teams that require dedicated space, while hot desks and coworking access serve short-term users, visiting teams, project groups, and professionals who need a flexible place to work.

It also includes a town hall and common pantry for business functions. The space can accommodate approximately 90 people in a dining setup and up to185 guests in a training or town hall configuration. It is also equipped with high-speed WiFi and complimentary coffee through high-end espresso machines.

The interiors bring together modern office design and a distinctly Ilonggo character. Inspired by the energy and artistry of the Dinagyang Festival, work.able Iloilo features rhythmic textures, layered details, locally woven elements, warm wood tones, earthy palettes, and locally sourced materials.

“work.able Iloilo was designed for businesses that need speed, flexibility, and operational support,” said Elton John Peralta, Senior Director and Head of work.able. “Through its serviced offices, scalable work areas, and end-to-end support, the center allows companies to set up or expand in Iloilo quickly while we manage their workspace requirements.”

The coworking area is open Mondays to Fridays, from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m., while private offices are primed to operate 24 hours a day, seven days a week, allowing teams to maintain business continuity and varying shift schedules.

The launch also comes as Robinsons Land celebrates 46 years of proven stability, reinforcing a diversified portfolio across offices, residences, malls, hotels, destination estates, sports and recreation facilities, and premium flexible workspaces.
For more information, visit workable.ph or email us at enablers@workable.ph.
